decisions.reason: The DCDC1 change compensates the main-board 3.3V OR-ing diode drop and does not alter the separate MT3608 5V boost rail, its enable control, or its interboard route.

The DCDC1 source is raised to 3.4V specifically so the main-board rail remains at 3.3V after the Schottky drop; the I2C pull-up voltage, resistance, topology, and signal-conditioning requirements therefore remain unchanged.
